summary.frequency_metadata: No explicit headway/frequency fields are exposed in the inspected non-deprecated Trip field list. This is not an exhaustive proof that no other OTP API path exists.
summary.conclusion: Trip geometry and stop sequence are available for both frequency trip templates; legacy stoptimes and stoptimesForDate returned null for both, without errors. No usable scheduled time offsets or headways were recovered by the tested API route. This does not establish OTP API as a sufficient replacement for retaining the active graph's temporal baseline.
limitations: Two broad/nested introspection queries were rejected by OTP BadFaithIntrospection guards.
Stoptime field types were read from official docs; selected fields were accepted by the live query but contained no stop-time rows.
No graph/source changes or fallback to a different date were used.
Full schema and other possible API data paths were not exhausted within the three-query budget.
